summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing the closing of an underwritten public offering of 26,066,667 ordinary shares at $3.75 per share, raising approximately $98 million in gross proceeds, including full exercise of the underwriters' option. Concurrently, the company completed a private placement of 17,826,666 ordinary shares at the same price to certain European investors for additional gross proceeds. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer is present; this is a routine capital raise.
